headline: Resolution would have required the President to end U.S. military hostilities against Iran unless Congress specifically approved them.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have directed the President to stop using U.S. Armed Forces in hostilities against Iran. The only exception would have been if Congress passed a declaration of war or a specific authorization for the use of military force against Iran. The Senate voted on June 27, 2025, not to move forward with it, so it did not pass.

who_it_affects.how: The President would have been required to end U.S. military hostilities against Iran that Congress had not specifically authorized.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. Armed Forces
who_it_affects.how: Troops would have been withdrawn from hostilities against Iran unless Congress approved the use of force.
Congress would have needed to pass a declaration of war or a specific authorization before U.S. forces could continue hostilities against Iran.
